usv-relay-link:ashbyhq:94b4cf10-9dce-45b.title: Chief of Staff Associate
usv-relay-link:ashbyhq:94b4cf10-9dce-45b.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.



THE TEAM
• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation



THE ROLE

You'll work directly alongside Relay's Chief of Staff, sitting at the center of the CEO's agenda and the company's most strategic priorities. This is a rare early-career role that gives you genuine access to how a high-growth company is led, scaled, and funded — from the inside.

You won't just support the leadership agenda. You'll help drive it.



What You'll Own

CEO Operating Rhythm

Support and continuously improve leadership meetings, all-hands, and company communications. Keep the organization focused on what matters most.

CEO Office Build-out

Play a founding role in designing and launching Relay's CEO Office — a new internal function that centralizes how the company's top priorities are tracked, escalated, and executed. You'll help build the playbooks, rituals, and governance structures from the ground up.

Next Potential Fundraising Round Support

Be a hands-on contributor to Relay's next potential fundraising round — supporting data room preparation, investor materials, strategic narratives, and cross-functional coordination as we enter our next phase of growth.

Strategic Execution

Translate company-level strategy into clear roadmaps, milestones, and ownership. Drive accountability on OKRs and follow through on delivery.

Cross-functional Coordination

Act as the connective tissue across teams — scoping and driving high-priority projects that require alignment across engineering, product, ops, and commercial.

People & Org Design

Contribute to workforce planning, role design, and people processes — from performance reviews to goal-setting — that help Relay scale without losing what makes it great.



What We're Looking For

• 2–4 years in consulting, a founder's office, or a high-growth startup in a strategy or operations role

• You turn ambiguous problems into structured solutions — and then execute them

• Excellent written and verbal communication; you make complex things clear

• Collaborative and trusted across functions; you build relationships fast

• Energized by pace, not slowed by it



Fast and Focused Hiring Process

• Talent Acquisition Interview – 30 min

• Hiring Manager Interview – 45 min

• Case Study / Strategic Scenario – 60 min

• Values & Team Interviews – 2 x 30 min

• Decision and offer within 48 hours



Who Thrives at Relay?

 - Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

 - Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

 - 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

 - All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

 - People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

 - Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.
   
   If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.



Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

valtruis-instride-health:greenhouse:4645.description:
About Us

InStride Health’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes. We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking. Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

Team InStride Health: Our Core Values

  • Give Heart: We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated. 
  • Work Smart: We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.
  • Have Humility: We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.
  • Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role

We are looking for a virtual Child & Adolescent Therapist to join our team to deliver family-centric and evidence-based care. This is a fully remote position. 

Responsibilities:

  • Provide evidence-based individual and group treatment to patients and families
  • Use measurement-based care to inform treatment planning
  • Collaborate with other care team members (e.g., coach and psychiatrist)
  • Provide feedback on program curricula and training protocols
  • Provide feedback regarding the various applications of technology in treatment
  • Maintain awareness of risk management issues
  • Complete documentation in a timely and thorough manner
  • Participate in initial and ongoing trainings on the application of evidence-based and tech-enhanced care delivery
  • Facilitate skills or skills practice groups, as assigned. These age-based groups, for patients or parents/caregivers, focus on skills development and implementation based on the InStride Health curriculum. These groups are based in CBT, and integrate aspects of ACT and PMT

What You Need to Succeed in the Role

  • LCSW from an accredited school of social work, or LPC & Masters degree from an accredited graduate program
  • Pennsylvania licensure appropriate to clinical discipline
  • Strong background in treating children and adolescents with anxiety and related disorders
  • Experience and training in delivering evidence-based treatments (e.g., CBT, ACT, DBT)        
  • Basic computer skills, facility with and openness to new technologies
  • Excellent written and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to be flexible and nimble and work well both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, mission driven environment
  • Culturally responsive with regard to diversity and inclusion
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information in a manner that inspires confidence and trust

The expected annual salary for this role is between $80,000-100,000. Actual starting salary will be determined on an individualized basis and will be based on several factors including but not limited to specific skill set, work experience, licensure, etc. Additional compensation may be considered based on factors such as licensure type, appropriate state licensure, prime time hour availability, and more.

Why Join Our Team

  • Generous benefits package (401k with match, Flexible PTO, paid holidays, paid service days, 4 week paid sabbatical, 12 week paid parental leave, health benefits starting on your first day, and more)
  • Opportunity to join a mission-driven company that is changing the landscape of pediatric mental health treatment
  • Chance to make a far-reaching impact by helping children and families access desperately-needed, evidence-based care
  • Opportunity to work with talented and experienced team members who have devoted their lives to solving this problem
  • Fully virtual: work from the comfort of your home with periodic in-person retreats

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, & Belonging (DEIB)

We want to make our clinical services available for everyone, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or how you identify. To achieve this, we recognize we must continually make progress in building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive team. Through these efforts, we support two primary objectives at InStride Health:

  1. Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.
  2. Building a mission-driven business that lasts. Specifically, we believe our commitment to a supportive culture improves innovation, decision-making, and efficiency.

We invite you to share any additional information about yourself or your experiences that may not be reflected in your CV. Inclusion of this information is completely voluntary.

Beware of fake job postings and offers. All official communications from InStride Health will come from email addresses ending in @instride.health. We will never ask for personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank details during the application process. If you receive a suspicious job offer or communication, please contact our recruitment team directly (talent@instride.health) to verify its authenticity.

verdane-eduhouse:teamtailor:8babae44-90a.title: AI Learning Specialist
verdane-eduhouse:teamtailor:8babae44-90a.description:
Brænder du for AI - og for at omsætte det til noget, virksomheder faktisk bruger i deres hverdag? 
Hos GoLearn søger vi en AI Learning Specialist, der vil tage ansvar for at udvikle og drive vores AI-område i Danmark. 
Det her er ikke en klassisk underviserrolle, men en strategisk nøgleposition, hvor du er med til at sætte retning, forme indhold og påvirke, hvordan virksomheder arbejder med AI i praksis. 
GoLearn er en del af Eduhouse og en af Nordens førende digitale læringspartnere. 
Vi arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, forretning og læring - og vores ambition er klar: Vi vil ikke bare levere kurser, men skabe reel adfærdsændring og forretningsværdi hos vores kunder. AI er et af de områder, hvor efterspørgslen vokser eksplosivt, og hvor behovet for praksisnær, anvendelig læring er større end nogensinde. Det er her, du kommer ind i billedet. 
Rollen - kort fortalt 
Du får ansvaret for at udvikle og løfte vores AI-kurser fra idé til færdigt produkt. Det indebærer, at du både arbejder strategisk med retning og operationelt med indhold og formidling. 
Dine primære opgaver bliver at: 
udvikle, producere og undervise i AI-kurser - både on-demand og live 
omsætte teknologier og trends til konkrete use cases, der giver mening i praksis 
sikre høj kvalitet og reel anvendelighed i alt indhold 
drive og videreudvikle vores AI-katalog i takt med markedets behov 
Din succes måles ikke på, hvad du ved - men på hvad vores kunder faktisk kan bruge bagefter. 
Hvorfor den her rolle er interessant 
Der er mange AI-roller derude lige nu, men få med det her setup. 
Du får reelt ejerskab over AI som fagområde i GoLearn i Danmark og bliver en central spiller i at definere retningen. Samtidig starter du ikke fra scratch, men bygger videre på et stærkt fundament og samarbejder tæt med nogle af de dygtigste profiler i feltet. 
Konkret betyder det, at du: 
får ansvar og indflydelse på at forme både strategi, indhold, scope og retning 
arbejder tæt sammen med vores AI-specialist i Finland, som allerede har udviklet en stærk playbook 
sparrer med nogle af Danmarks dygtigste AI-eksperter om indhold og kvalitet 
arbejder med læring, der skaber reel adfærdsændring og forretningsværdi 
Hvem du er 
Vi leder ikke efter en klassisk underviser, men en fagligt stærk person, der arbejder praktisk med AI og evner at gøre det anvendeligt for andre. 
Du: 
har hands-on erfaring med AI i praksis 
kan omsætte komplekse teknologier til noget konkret og brugbart 
arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dit område 
har en høj faglig standard og går ikke på kompromis med kvaliteten 
opsøger aktivt sparring og bruger den til at løfte dit arbejde 
Du er med andre ord en do’er med stærk faglighed - ikke en teoretiker. 
Din baggrund 
Vi forventer ikke én bestemt vej ind i rollen, men selvfølgelig har du: 
erfaring med AI-værktøjer som ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini eller Claude 
erfaring med at arbejde med AI i praksis 
stærke formidlingsevner - både skriftligt og mundtligt 
Har en stærk interesse for AI og følger udviklingen tæt - både i praksis og på tværs af relevante platforme. 
Erfaring med undervisning, e-learning eller contentproduktion er en fordel, men ikke et krav. 
Hvordan du kommer til at arbejde 
Du bliver en del af vores Content & Production team og får en central rolle i et stærkt fagligt setup. 
Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med: 
Head of Learning (didaktisk kvalitet) 
vores AI-kollega i Finland og øvrige nordiske kolleger (ift. sparring og skalering) 
det kommercielle team (ift. behov i markedet) 
eksterne AI-specialister (ift. faglig sparring, udvikling og indhold) 
Kulturen i GoLearn er uformel og ambitiøs med højt tempo, høj faglighed og en stærk sparringskultur - og med plads til humor i hverdagen. 
Praktisk 
Stillingen er fuldtid med arbejdsplads i Ballerup og mulighed for hjemmearbejde en dag om ugen. Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke, gode vilkår og godt arbejdsmiljø. 
Vi ved, at de bedste kandidater ikke nødvendigvis bruger lang tid på ansøgninger.   
Derfor beder vi dig blot sende dit CV inkl. 3-5 linjer om, hvorfor rollen er interessant for dig 
Så tager vi den derfra. 
Vi screener og indkalder løbende til samtaler, og da opslaget kun er eksponeret i en kort periode, anbefaler vi, at du ikke venter med at søge. 
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Lærke Norup Rothenborg fra Rothenborg Consulting på tlf. 30412999 eller lr@rothenborgconsulting.dk der hjælper os med denne rekruttering. 
Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

yc-verifiable:lever:5a01eded-7e4c-473d-8.description:
About Us: 
 
Verifiable is a provider credentialing and network monitoring platform, delivery industry-leading AI, API and Software solutions to help healthcare organizations optimize operations at enterprise scale. We are a top Salesforce partner, winning the 2024 Salesforce Partner Innovation Award, and also were named to Inc. 5000 2025, the most prestigious ranking of America's fastest-growing private companies. We work with leading healthcare organizations such as Humana Dental, Talkspace, Headway, Empower Pharmacy, and many others.
 
Verifiable is a fast-moving, early-stage team that values impact, ownership, and follow-through. Everyone here rolls up their sleeves, dives into ambiguity, and takes end-to-end responsibility for meaningful work. Priorities shift, problems aren’t always perfectly defined, and we move with urgency—so we look for people who are energized by hard problems, rapid learning, and stepping in wherever the team needs support.
 
We’re collaborative and human, but we keep a high bar. If you thrive in a scrappy, high-ownership environment where your work directly shapes the company’s trajectory, you’ll feel right at home here.

  • Demo and sell to our largest, most complex prospective new accounts in the healthcare space

  • Manage complex sales cycles through the entire process

  • Help Verifiable gather market share post-product/market fit in a thriving industry with lots of greenfield opportunity

  • Articulate compelling value propositions to senior decision makers

  • Communicate cross-functionally to help the whole team iterate on approach, flex to market changes, and learn from each other to tackle the enterprise segment

  • 5+ years of closing experience with 6 and 7 figure deals
